sentences.text: Stephen J. Ditko -LRB- -LSB- ˈdɪtkoʊ -RSB- born November 2 , 1927 -RRB- is an American comic book artist and writer best known as the artist and co-creator , with Stan Lee , of the Marvel Comics superheroes Spider-Man and Doctor Strange .	Doctor Strange	Doctor Strange	comic book	comic book	Stan Lee	Stan Lee	Marvel Comics	Marvel Comics	Spider-Man	Spider-Man

Ditko studied under Batman artist Jerry Robinson at the Cartoonist and Illustrators School in New York City .	Batman	Batman	Jerry Robinson	Jerry Robinson	Cartoonist and Illustrators School	Cartoonist and Illustrators School

He began his professional career in 1953 , working in the studio of Joe Simon and Jack Kirby , beginning as an inker and coming under the influence of artist Mort Meskin .	Joe Simon	Joe Simon	Jack Kirby	Jack Kirby	Mort Meskin	Mort Meskin
During this time , he then began his long association with Charlton Comics , where he did work in the genres of science fiction , horror , and mystery .	Charlton Comics	Charlton Comics
He also co-created the superhero Captain Atom in 1960 .	Captain Atom	Captain Atom	superhero	superhero
During the 1950s , Ditko also drew for Atlas Comics , a forerunner of Marvel Comics .	Marvel Comics	Marvel Comics	Atlas Comics	Atlas Comics (1950s)
He went on to contribute much significant work to Marvel .

In 1966 , after being the exclusive artist on The Amazing Spider-Man and the `` Doctor Strange '' feature in Strange Tales , Ditko left Marvel for reasons never specified .	The Amazing Spider-Man	The Amazing Spider-Man	Doctor Strange	Doctor Strange	Spider-Man	Spider-Man	Strange Tales	Strange Tales

Ditko continued to work for Charlton and also DC Comics , making major contributions , including a revamp of the long-running character Blue Beetle , and creating or co-creating the Question , the Creeper , Shade , the Changing Man , and Hawk and Dove .	Creeper	Creeper (comics)	Hawk and Dove	Hawk and Dove	Question	Question (comics)	Blue Beetle	Blue Beetle	DC Comics	DC Comics

Ditko also began contributing to small independent publishers , where he created Mr. A , a hero reflecting the influence of Ayn Rand 's philosophy of Objectivism .	Mr. A	Mr. A	Ayn Rand	Ayn Rand	Objectivism	Objectivism (Ayn Rand)
Since the 1960s , Ditko has declined most interviews , stating that it is his work he offers readers , not his personality .

Ditko was inducted into the comics industry 's Jack Kirby Hall of Fame in 1990 , and into the Will Eisner Award Hall of Fame in 1994 .
